verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents built-in AI: 'Analytics AI, part of Mailchimp with Intuit Intelligence', which explains which campaigns drive revenue, plus a pricing-page line item for 'Generative AI features'. Neither shows an assistant you can hand tasks to and have it carry them out. The 'create campaigns with the AI you already use' claim describes an external chat AI, not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-product assistant that accepts and executes delegated tasks, documentation of what the generative AI features actually do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Analytics AI, part of Mailchimp with Intuit Intelligence, explains which campaigns and automations are actually moving revenue—and the plain-language reason why—so you can double down on what works.
every recommendation is grounded in your store’s real sales, campaigns, and customer behavior.
